many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# hypothesis H: shift shape until it touches the 2-bar (on the side it faces); draw full-height 8 column at the shape's original rightmost column.
def f(I):
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    O=[r[:] for r in I]
    bg=Counter(x for r in I for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    bar_col=None
    # find the 2-column
    for j in range(W):
        if all(r[j]==2 for r in I): bar_col=j; break
    sc={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if I[i][j] not in (bg,2)}
    lo=min(j for _,j in sc); hi=max(j for _,j in sc)
    step = 1 if lo>bar_col+1 or True else -1
    # determine direction: shape must end adjacent to bar on its current side
    if lo>bar_col: step=-1   # shape right of bar -> slide left
    elif hi<bar_col: step=1
    # target: edge adjacent to bar
    tgt_left = bar_col+1 if lo>bar_col else None
    tgt_right = bar_col-1 if hi<bar_col else None
    if lo>bar_col:
        d = (bar_col+1)-lo
    else:
        d = (bar_col-1)-hi
    newsc={(i,j+d) for i,j in sc}
    for i,j in sc: O[i][j]=bg
    for i,j in newsc: O[i][j]=I[i][j]
    eight = hi   # original rightmost column
    for i in range(H): O[i][eight]=8
    return O
